【申请人：蕾拉（A级哨兵）】

【申请时间：今天14:30】

【备注：秦夙向导，我有话想跟你说，请一定不要拒绝我的申请，万分感恩。】

秦夙愣了一下。

蕾拉？这么快？

她想了想，指尖悬在“确认“按钮上停了两秒，然后点了下去。

两点半，疏导中心，3号疏导室。

秦夙提前到了，打量了一圈这间房间。

跟之前两次用过的没啥不同。

雪白的墙壁，柔和的隔音材质，角落里摆着白噪音发生器，发出类似山涧溪流的沙沙声。

一张治疗椅，一张沙发，简约得有些冷淡，但她已经习惯。

敲门声响起。

“请进。“

蕾拉推门进来，一身黑色作战服，浅棕色的头发扎成低马尾，比披着头发时更柔和几分。

“秦夙向导，谢谢你愿意见我。“说话风格，也还是软软糯糯的。

秦夙指了指沙发，“坐吧。“

她自己也拉过一把椅子坐下，开门见山，“你不是单纯来做疏导的吧？“

蕾拉垂下眼睛，手指绞在一起，“我是想来聊聊诺亚的事。有些事情……我觉得您应该知道。“

居然用“您”，有被尊敬到。

秦夙没接话，等着她继续。

“诺亚他……其实不是您看到的那样。“蕾拉的声音很轻，“他跟萧岑向导真的很好，是很好的朋友。诺亚在塔里没什么朋友，但萧岑向导从来不在意他说话难听，还会给他带自己做的小点心，疏导的时候也特别耐心。诺亚很珍惜她。“

“萧岑向导牺牲之后，诺亚一直在说，是他没用，没能保护好她。“

秦夙沉默了一会儿。

很难把诺亚那张嚣张的脸和“珍惜一个人“联系起来，但蕾拉的表情不像在撒谎。

“萧岑跟离颂呢？“秦夙试着问。

蕾拉的脸色明显变的为难起来，“这个……我不好说。“

“不好说，还是不想跟我说？“

蕾拉犹豫了好久，叹口气，“萧岑向导在队里的时候其实很快乐。但每次有人提到离长官，她的情绪就会变得很低落。我有一次不小心看到她一个人哭了很久，那天之前一点时间，她是去见过离长官的，但他们之间具体发生了什么，我真的不清楚。“

秦夙把这些话默默记在心里。

[Applicant: Layla (A-level Sentinel)]

[Application time: 14:30 today]

[Remarks: Guide Qin Su, I have something to tell you. Please do not reject my application. I am extremely grateful.】

Qin Su was stunned for a moment.

Layla?So fast?

She thought for a moment, paused with her fingertips on the "Confirm" button for two seconds, and then clicked it.

Two-thirty, counseling center, counseling room 3.

Qin Su arrived early and looked around the room.

It’s no different than what I’ve used twice before.

Snow-white walls, soft soundproofing materials, and a white noise generator placed in the corner make a rustling sound similar to a mountain stream.

A treatment chair and a sofa were simple and a bit cold, but she was used to them.

There was a knock on the door.

"Please come in."

Layla opened the door and walked in. She was wearing a black combat uniform and her light brown hair was tied into a low ponytail, which was a bit softer than when she wore her hair down.

"Guide Qin Su, thank you for being willing to see me." His speaking style was still soft and waxy.

Qin Su pointed to the sofa and said, "Sit down."

She also pulled up a chair and sat down, getting straight to the point, "You're not just here to provide guidance, are you?"

Layla lowered her eyes and twisted her fingers together, "I want to talk about Noah. There are some things... I think you should know."

I actually used "you" and was respected.

Qin Su didn't answer and waited for her to continue.

"Noah...is actually not what you see." Layla's voice was very soft. "He and Guide Xiao Cen are really good friends and are very good friends. Noah doesn't have many friends in the tower, but Guide Xiao Cen never cares about his harsh words. He will also bring him snacks made by himself, and he is also very patient when guiding him. Noah cherishes her very much."

"After Guide Xiao Cen died, Noah kept saying that he was useless and failed to protect her."

Qin Su was silent for a while.

It's hard to connect Noah's arrogant face with "cherishing someone", but Layla's expression doesn't look like she's lying.

"Where are Xiao Cen and Li Song?" Qin Su tried to ask.

Layla's face became obviously embarrassed, "This... I can't say."

"It's hard to tell, or you still don't want to tell me?"

Leila hesitated for a long time and sighed, "Guide Xiao Cen was actually very happy when she was in the team. But every time someone mentioned Commander Li, her mood would become very depressed. I once accidentally saw her crying alone for a long time. A little before that day, she went to see Commander Li, but I really don't know what happened between them."

Qin Su silently remembered these words in his heart.
